title: NuScale US600 模組設計研究
subcategoryTitle: 小型模組化與先進反應爐
summary: 以整合式壓水模組與共用水池解析NuScale US600 模組設計研究：六個原理與架構單元、十二項可保存的分析及驗證作業，附假想量化例、來源及衍生工程比較。
summaryEn: Explore NuScale US600 modular design study through integral pwr modules and a shared pool: six principle/architecture units and twelve saved analysis/validation tasks, with an assumed numerical example, primary sources and related engineering comparisons.
scope: 和平民用發電與融合研究的公開熱循環、功能架構及工程證據。核能不包含燃料製備、濃縮、武器、反應性整定或反應爐操作；地熱、風電及水力不提供未經場址驗證的施工／操作參數。算例皆是假想，實機由合格專業團隊依規範負責。
scopeEn: Public thermal cycles, functional architecture and engineering evidence for peaceful generation/fusion research. Nuclear content excludes fuel production, enrichment, weapons, reactivity settings and reactor operations. Geothermal/wind/hydro supply no unverified construction/operation settings. Examples are hypothetical; qualified professionals govern actual equipment.
v30Focus: 一體化模組的定量檢核：自然循環、整體效應試驗、共用水池熱沉與首座計畫的成本
v30FocusEn: Quantitative checks of an integral module: natural circulation, integral testing, the shared pool as heat sink and the cost of the first project

stages.title: 系統邊界與基本原理
stages.description: 在NuScale US600 模組設計研究案例中比較整合模組熱流體邊界與模組與淨髮電，各完成分析及驗證。
stages.descriptionEn: Analyze and validate integral-module fluid boundaries and modules/net generation within the NuScale US600 modular design study case.

steps.title: 核島與汽輪機島邊界：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Nuclear and turbine-island boundaries: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對整合模組熱流體邊界提出可反駁的核島與汽輪機島邊界模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable nuclear and turbine-island boundaries model and evidence record for integral-module fluid boundaries.
steps.instruction: 在「NuScale US600 模組設計研究」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識整合模組熱流體邊界。和平發電以熱源、換熱與汽輪發電連接；壓水、沸水與重水架構的流體邊界不同。 建立核島與汽輪機島邊界的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是整合式壓水模組與共用水池。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。在原創塊圖分開熱流、電流與流體連通。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify integral-module fluid boundaries in the mentor diagram and primary sources for NuScale US600 modular design study. Civil generation connects a heat source, transfer and turbine generation; PWR, BWR and heavy-water layouts have different fluid boundaries. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of nuclear and turbine-island boundaries, focusing on integral pwr modules and a shared pool. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate heat, electrical and fluid paths in an original block diagram. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 在原創塊圖分開熱流、電流與流體連通。
steps.observationEn: Separate heat, electrical and fluid paths in an original block diagram.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：所有核電架構都有完全相同的主次迴路。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: All nuclear architectures have identical primary/secondary loops.
steps.check: 提交整合模組熱流體邊界的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for integral-module fluid boundaries.

knowledge.title: 核島與汽輪機島邊界
knowledge.text: 和平發電以熱源、換熱與汽輪發電連接；壓水、沸水與重水架構的流體邊界不同。 本課架構對應：整合模組熱流體邊界
knowledge.textEn: Civil generation connects a heat source, transfer and turbine generation; PWR, BWR and heavy-water layouts have different fluid boundaries. Course architecture correspondence: Integral-module fluid boundaries

knowledge.title: 獨立驗證與失效邊界
knowledge.text: 在原創塊圖分開熱流、電流與流體連通。 應逐項保留基準與不確定度；所有核電架構都有完全相同的主次迴路。 是本單元要排除的誤解。
knowledge.textEn: Separate heat, electrical and fluid paths in an original block diagram. Retain each reference and uncertainty; reject the misconception: All nuclear architectures have identical primary/secondary loops.

knowledge.title: 原創假想量化練習
knowledge.text: 假設民用熱源 600 MWth、熱電效率 0.32、輔機 11 MWe，淨電=600×0.32−11=181.0 MWe；循環排熱約408.0 MW。僅熱平衡，不含反應性、燃料製造或操作整定。
knowledge.textEn: Assume civil heat input 600 MWth, efficiency 0.32 and auxiliaries 11 MWe: net power 181.0 MWe; cycle rejection about 408.0 MW. This is heat balance only, without reactivity, fuel manufacture or operating settings.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「NuScale US600 模組設計研究」的「核島與汽輪機島邊界：架構分析」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出能源輸入、轉換、儲存、輔助負載與有用輸出的邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「能源站：把損失算回來」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與同時間窗的能源表、儲能狀態、損失項及設備範圍的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Nuclear and turbine-island boundaries: architecture analysis” in “NuScale US600 modular design study”. Draw the energy input, conversion, storage, auxiliary loads and useful-output boundaries; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Energy Station: Account for the Losses” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for same-window energy accounts, storage state, loss terms and equipment boundary, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 就整合模組熱流體邊界的「核島與汽輪機島邊界」，哪個推論或驗證成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which inference or check is justified for nuclear and turbine-island boundaries in integral-module fluid boundaries?
options: 和平發電以熱源、換熱與汽輪發電連接；壓水、沸水與重水架構的流體邊界不同。
所有核電架構都有完全相同的主次迴路。
兩個案例的平均相同，就足以排除空間、時間及模型誤差。
optionsEn: Civil generation connects a heat source, transfer and turbine generation; PWR, BWR and heavy-water layouts have different fluid boundaries.
All nuclear architectures have identical primary/secondary loops.
Equal case averages rule out spatial, temporal and model errors.
quiz.explanation: 和平發電以熱源、換熱與汽輪發電連接；壓水、沸水與重水架構的流體邊界不同。 在原創塊圖分開熱流、電流與流體連通。
quiz.explanationEn: Civil generation connects a heat source, transfer and turbine generation; PWR, BWR and heavy-water layouts have different fluid boundaries. Separate heat, electrical and fluid paths in an original block diagram.

steps.objective: 針對整合模組熱流體邊界提出可反駁的核島與汽輪機島邊界模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable nuclear and turbine-island boundaries model and evidence record for integral-module fluid boundaries.
steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「核島與汽輪機島邊界」模型，檢查整合模組熱流體邊界的兩個假想案例。在原創塊圖分開熱流、電流與流體連通。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分和平發電以熱源、換熱與汽輪發電連接；壓水、沸水與重水架構的流體邊界不同。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous nuclear and turbine-island boundaries model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving integral-module fluid boundaries. Separate heat, electrical and fluid paths in an original block diagram. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "Civil generation connects a heat source, transfer and turbine generation; PWR, BWR and heavy-water layouts have different fluid boundaries." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.

steps.observationEn: Separate heat, electrical and fluid paths in an original block diagram.

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: All nuclear architectures have identical primary/secondary loops.
steps.check: 提交整合模組熱流體邊界的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for integral-module fluid boundaries.

steps.title: 熱循環與淨電效率：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Thermal cycles and net efficiency: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對模組與淨髮電提出可反駁的熱循環與淨電效率模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable thermal cycles and net efficiency model and evidence record for modules/net generation.
steps.instruction: 在「NuScale US600 模組設計研究」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識模組與淨髮電。熱電轉換受熱循環及輔機耗電共同影響；熱功率與淨電功率不同。 建立熱循環與淨電效率的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是整合式壓水模組與共用水池。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。用假想熱平衡分別計算汽輪輸出、輔機與淨電。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify modules/net generation in the mentor diagram and primary sources for NuScale US600 modular design study. Cycle efficiency and auxiliaries affect conversion; thermal and net electrical power differ. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of thermal cycles and net efficiency, focusing on integral pwr modules and a shared pool. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate turbine output, auxiliaries and net power in an assumed balance. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 用假想熱平衡分別計算汽輪輸出、輔機與淨電。
steps.observationEn: Separate turbine output, auxiliaries and net power in an assumed balance.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：熱功率增加量必然等於可送電增加量。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Added thermal power necessarily equals added export power.
steps.check: 提交模組與淨髮電的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for modules/net generation.
